harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) to route between lan-a (node2) and lan-b (node3) using an Ansible playbook run from node4 (control_node). Statically addressed node1's eth1 (10.50.10.254/24) and eth2 (10.50.20.254/24) via VyOS configure/commit/save, statically addressed node2's enp8s0 (10.50.10.11/24) and node3's enp8s0 (10.50.20.12/24) via nmcli, added static routes on node2/node3 pointing to node1 for the peer subnet, and trusted the peer subnet in firewalld so any port is reachable. Verified with ping and TCP (HTTP) traffic in both directions, using tcpdump to confirm source IPs are preserved end-to-end (no NAT/masquerade). Bootstrapped SSH access for Ansible using the cluster SSH keypair (added to VyOS user 'vyos' and root on node2/node3; node4 uses the cluster private key). Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol on all four nodes sequentially, confirming changed boot_id and full recovery of routing/connectivity/ansible tooling after each restart.
actions_performed: Explored network topology on node1-node4 to confirm mgmt/lan-a/lan-b NIC assignments per task.toml
Bootstrapped passwordless SSH from node4 (control_node) to node1 (vyos user) and node2/node3 (root) using the cluster SSH keypair
Wrote /root/inventory.ini and /root/lan-routing.yml on node4
Ansible play 1: configured VyOS node1 eth1/eth2 static addresses via configure/commit/save (newline-separated to satisfy VyOS's non-interactive alias expansion requirement)
Ansible play 2: configured static IP (nmcli) and peer-subnet static routes on node2/node3; added firewalld trusted-zone rule for the peer subnet
Verified ping and HTTP/TCP reachability in both directions with tcpdump proving original source IPs are preserved (no NAT)
Captured pre-restart baseline (boot_id, uptime, routes/services) on all 4 nodes
Sequentially restarted node2, node3, node4, then node1 via native reboot mechanisms, polling each until exec was available again
Verified changed boot_id and low uptime on each node post-restart

Re-verified VyOS interface config, node2/node3 static IP+route persistence, ansible tooling/SSH access on node4, and full node2<->node3 ping+HTTP reachability with source-address preservation after all restarts

evidence.requirement: node1 configured (via Ansible) to route between lan-a and lan-b
evidence.summary: Ansible playbook run shows VyOS eth1=10.50.10.254/24, eth2=10.50.20.254/24 committed and saved; node2/node3 static IPs and routes configured successfully

evidence.requirement: node2 and node3 can reach each other directly on any port
evidence.summary: curl HTTP 200 from node2->node3:5000 and node3->node2:6000 on arbitrary non-standard ports, plus post-restart re-verification
tcpdump on receiving node's LAN interface shows TCP SYN with source IP = sender's real LAN-a/LAN-b address (10.50.10.11 / 10.50.20.12), not node1's address, in both directions and after final restart
inventory.ini and lan-routing.yml created on node4 (control_node); ansible-playbook executed successfully against vyos_router and lan_hosts groups
Pre-restart boot_id bccb87ac..., static IP 10.50.10.11/24 and peer route present

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Reboot command acknowledged before disconnect; exec unreachable during reboot; new boot_id fd0a9d52... with uptime 4.83s confirms restart
Post-restart: enp8s0 still 10.50.10.11/24, peer route present, ping to node3 succeeds
Pre-restart boot_id fb2aa416..., static IP 10.50.20.12/24 and peer route present

evidence.requirement: node3 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged, exec unreachable during reboot, new boot_id 0a407491... with uptime 4.41s confirms restart
Post-restart: enp8s0 still 10.50.20.12/24, peer route present, ping to node2 succeeds
Pre-restart boot_id 6fd57414..., sshd socket listening on :22

evidence.requirement: node4 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged, exec unreachable during reboot, new boot_id 785c5621... with uptime 3.59s confirms restart
Post-restart: ansible-playbook binary present, inventory.ini intact, SSH to node2 via cluster key succeeds
Pre-restart boot_id 50503c5d..., VyOS show interfaces confirms eth1/eth2 addressed and up

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged, exec unreachable/reset during reboot, new boot_id f217eb21... with uptime 21.84s confirms restart

evidence.requirement: node1 recovered state and cluster-wide functional recovery after final restart
evidence.summary: Post-restart VyOS show interfaces confirms eth1/eth2 config persisted; node2<->node3 ping and HTTP succeed with source IP preservation confirmed via tcpdump
